changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO modeling_catalog_indicator_serving_projection(tenant_id,indicator_id,indicator_version,sync_status,next_sync_at) SELECT 'default',v.indicator_id,v.version,'SYNC_PENDING',now() FROM gov_indicator_version v JOIN gov_indicator_definition d ON d.id=v.indicator_id WHERE v.status='PUBLISHED' AND d.metric_type IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(d.category,'') NOT IN ('MODIFIER','TIME_PERIOD') ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,indicator_id,indicator_version) DO NOTHING;
